title: Manchester People’s Panel shapes a proposed public-facing Caddy AI advice service
summary: Manchester residents proposed safeguards for a public-facing Caddy service. Wider access to understandable advice remains intended; the panel’s design recommendations are reported.
account: Citizens Advice SORT’s Stuart Pearson reports that Manchester’s People’s Panel considered three proposals for public-facing Caddy and proposed a fourth. Residents called for client choice, human escalation for red flags, and transparency. They also identified that the public would lack trained advisers’ prompting skills. These were human-generated recommendations for an intended AI advice service. The source does not establish deployment of that design or improved client outcomes. An Open University interview connects the council-funded panel to Caddy’s July 2024 review. The roadshows’ educational gains and Caddy’s separately evaluated service outcomes are not attributed to this proposed application.
purpose: Extend access to understandable advice through a proposed public-facing AI service with human escalation and user choice.
system: Proposed public-facing Caddy AI advice service
developer: Citizens Advice Stockport, Oldham, Rochdale and Trafford
deployer: Citizens Advice Stockport, Oldham, Rochdale and Trafford (proposed public-facing service)

ratings.reason: Advice recipients are intended beneficiaries. The proposed design has no established client outcome.
Citizens Advice received specific design input. Its contribution to service capability and performance remains unassessed.

ai_role.statement: Caddy would support public-facing advice. The panel generated the design recommendations; the intended AI contribution to advice outcomes has not been evaluated.

evidence.citation: Stuart Pearson, Citizens Advice SORT, public LinkedIn post, September 2, 2026. First-person account of proposed service design and panel feedback. Publication date verified in the page’s structured metadata.
evidence.title: Citizens Advice Should Be the Trusted AI Advice Service

First-person account of Citizens Advice SORT’s July 2024 presentation, used to establish continuity with the council-funded panel. Exact publication date not displayed.

produced_by: A resident panel supplied design recommendations to the proposed service’s developer. No resulting AI-produced benefit is established.
must_hold: Implementation and evaluation would be needed to determine whether the proposed service improves access. The sources do not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce a benefit.
